rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Armor
rules.description: Counts as having Defense X+.

rules.name: Bane
rules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking, the target must re-roll unmodified Defense results of 6.

rules.name: Bounding
rules.description: When this unit is activated, you may move all models with this rule in it by up to D3+1".

rules.name: Caster
rules.description: Gets X spell tokens at the start of each round, but can’t have more than 6 at once. Once per activation, before attacking, spend as many tokens as the spell’s value to try casting one or more spells (only one try per spell). Pick a target and roll one die, and on 4+ resolve the spell’s effect. Models within 18” of the Caster may spend any number of spell tokens at the same time before rolling to give the Caster +1/-1 to the roll per token.

rules.name: Counter
rules.description: May strike first with this weapon when charged, unless this unit is Fatigued.

rules.name: Counter in Melee Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Counter on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Crossing Strike
rules.description: Once per activation, when this model moves through enemy units, pick one of them and attack it with this weapon as if it was shooting. This weapon may only be used in this way.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Enhanced Predator
rules.description: If this model has Predator, it gets extra attacks on successful unmodified hit results of 5-6 from Predator (instead of only on 6).

rules.name: Enhanced Primal
rules.description: If this model has Primal, it gets extra attacks on successful unmodified hit results of 5-6 from Primal (instead of only on 6).

rules.name: Enhanced Primal Buff
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, pick up to 3 friendly units within 12", which gets Enhanced Primal once (next time the effect would apply).

rules.name: Evasive
rules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls when attacking units where most models have this rule.

rules.name: Fortified
rules.description: When units where most models have this rule take hits, those hits count as having AP(-1), to a min. of AP(0).

rules.name: Furious
rules.description: When charging, unmodified result of 6 to hit deal 1 extra hit (only the original hit counts as a 6 for special rules).

rules.name: Good Shot
rules.description: This model gets +1 to hit rolls when shooting.

rules.name: Heavy Impact
rules.description: Counts as having Impact(X) with hits that have AP(1).

rules.name: Hero
rules.description: Units within 6” of friendly Heroes may use the Hero’s Quality for Morale Tests as long as the Hero isn’t Shaken.

rules.name: Impact
rules.description: When charging, before either unit attacks, roll X dice, unless this unit is Fatigued. For each 2+ the target takes 1 hit.

rules.name: Precise
rules.description: Gets +1 to hit when attacking.

rules.name: Precision Target
rules.description: Once per game, during this model's activation, before attacking, pick X enemy units within 18" and in line of sight of it, and place one token on them. Friendly units get +1 to hit rolls when attacking them.

rules.name: Predator
rules.description: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

rules.name: Primal
rules.description: For each unmodified roll of 6 to hit when attacking, this model may roll +1 attack with that weapon. This rule doesn’t apply to newly generated attacks.

rules.name: Protection Feat
rules.description: Once per game, when this unit takes wounds and most of its models have this rule, you may use this rule and roll one die per wound, and on a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Puncture
rules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Defense 2+ to Defense 3+, this weapon gets AP(+2).

rules.name: Rapid Charge Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game moves +4" when using Charge actions. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Rending
rules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and for each unmodified result of 6 to hit, those hits get AP(+4).

rules.name: Rending when Shooting Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Rending on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Scout
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. After all other units are deployed, may be deployed anywhere fully within 9” of their deployment zone, over 9” away from non-Scout enemy units. Players alternate in placing Scout units, starting with the player that activates next.

rules.name: Scout Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Scout. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Shred
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

rules.name: Spell Conduit
rules.description: Casters within 12" that are from other friendly units may cast spells as if they were in this model's position, and get +1 to casting rolls when doing so. Friendly casters may only use this rule if this unit isn't Shaken.

rules.name: Teleport
rules.description: Once per activation, before attacking, you may place this model anywhere fully within 3" of its position when using Advance/Charge actions, or fully within 6" of its position when using Rush actions.

rules.name: Unique Hero
rules.description: Counts as having Hero, and this model may only be taken once per army.

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
rules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

rules.name: Vanguard
rules.description: After this model is deployed, it may be placed anywhere fully within 9" of its position, over 9" away from non-Vanguard enemy units.

spells.name: Celestial Roar
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Enhanced Primal once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Fateful Guidance
spells.effect: Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Furious once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Jaguar Blaze
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 6 hits with Shred.

spells.name: Piranha Curse
spells.effect: Pick up to two enemy units within 9", which take 4 hits each.

spells.name: Serpent Comet
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 12" in line of sight, which takes 2 hits with Puncture.

spells.name: Toxin Mist
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Bane on their weapons when attacking against once (next time the effect would apply).
